quotes.title: HD 86226
quotes.card: HD 86226 is a star with a pair of orbiting exoplanet companions, found in the constellation of Hydra.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 7.93, it is too dim to be visible with the naked eye.

notes: HD 86226 b: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
